description: DR-278 and DR-281 class optimization (kernel plan v2 of DR-168, section 7, slimmed): public store.search of int8 stores with and without the int8 prefilter, base against candidate, on the 859,346 WikiText-103 training paragraphs (wikitext-train, int8 rows, 2 workers, k 10). Three cells: o1-d256-q8 (typical, d256), o2-d1024-q8 (large, d1024) and the edge cell r5-int8-d1024-q1-rows (rows= spread over 50 percent of the rows, d1024, one query). The queries are 256 fixed STS-B test texts outside the store (PCG64 seed 0, digest in every record), encoded outside the timer; every call searches the next block of queries and a group starts at the first block, so both builds run the same calls and their outputs must be bit-identical. The sizing aims at 2.5 s (1.25 times target_seconds 2.0, the floor of the rules) for the faster observed arm, and every later measured group must reach at least target_seconds; both arms run the same number of calls, so with the candidate faster the base group is longer by the factor of the speed-up. 15 pairs, A/A tuning, A/A validation, comparison and confirmation unchanged. Rule, fixed before the measurement: the variant neon-sdot is enabled only if o1 and o2 are each at least 10 percent faster (saving at least max(3 * A/A IQR, 0.02), confirmed with at least half of it, evaluated by the cells@1 decision block) and r5 does not get slower (median of the paired factor base/candidate at least 0.98 and the confirmation not below it; r5 has decision_gate false and is assessed explicitly from the paired factor, not from the descriptive_only tool label). Otherwise nothing is enabled and no range is cut afterwards; the data go to the maintainer. A missing cell is inconclusive. Budget 8 h wall time, set by --wall-time-seconds 28800 (without it the tool takes 7200 s), never extended, never repeated. active_calibration_seconds per cell (sizing, A/A tuning and validation): o1 4500, o2 5400, r5 3600. Expected duration at the first tier (2 s) about 5.4 h (4.4 to 6.5 h); a second tier (4 s) is planned at about 9.8 h, over the budget; the first limit reached (wall budget: inconclusive_budget, calibration cap: inconclusive_noise) decides the status, and stopping before the second tier is a manual rule. Local development indication on one machine, no publication. Measure only in a window that fse-main grants.
